summary: CPU feature probe (stdcall): executes the cpuid instruction with EAX = 1 and returns whether EDX bit 23 (the mask 0x800000) is set, i.e. whether the probed feature flag is present.

operations.description: Set EAX = 1 to select cpuid leaf 1 before executing cpuid.
Execute the cpuid instruction (inline asm); the feature flags are returned in EDX.
Test (EDX & 0x800000) != 0, where 0x800000 is the bit mask taken from the constant global unk_800000 at 0x00800000; the boolean result is returned.
Return TRUE when the 0x800000 feature bit is set in cpuid leaf-1 EDX, otherwise FALSE.
Called by sub_50FC7D (0x0050FC7D), which relies on this probe when checking CPU capabilities.

unresolved: The specific CPU feature named by EDX bit 23 (0x800000) is not identified in the packet; the raw source references it only through the constant global unk_800000.
